questions: Can we choose the same bag for both A and B (self-move)?
Is the operation allowed to be performed zero times, i.e., is the initial configuration included?
Are we allowed to move stones from a bag that ends up empty after the move, and can that bag be chosen again later?
Does the order of bags matter for the XOR, i.e., is B_1 the label of the bag or the final stone count in the bag originally labeled 1?
Are the bags distinguishable after operations, i.e., do we track stones per original label or per current physical bag?
Is the XOR taken over the N values in the final configuration, even if some bags are empty?
Can we choose bags based on their current stone counts, or only by their original labels?
Is there any constraint on the total number of stones (e.g., conservation), or can stones be created/destroyed?
